contexts.text: When the persons were presented against whom they had felt hatred, there resulted a lamentable state, for whatever men have thought and plotted against another stands forth.
The man who... is in truth alone... is against all: (like Ishmael).
Here is described the first state of those... who are against the good of charity, and consequently against the Lord... AC 2401.
He wills not to know truths, for they are against his life, and the things that are against his life he also denies.
It was thus shown how the men of this earth are at this day against the inward man.
Hence it is that... the natural man is against the spiritual...
Sirens... being against all spiritual and celestial things, cannot see other Spirits except those who are in sensual lumen.
There reigns universally a negative against the Divine influx and government.
The hand against anyone = to do violence.
a. They account as enemies all who are against them and their evils.
On those who are against the Word.
The love of parents for their children.

The Lord cannot act against the laws of the Divine Providence, because to act against them would be to act against His Divine love and against His Divine wisdom, thus against Himself. General article.

Who cannot see that these things are diametrically contrary to the Divine Essence itself, that is, contrary to His Divine love and wisdom, and at the same time contrary to His omnipotence and omnipresence? No good master could act thus against his domestics...
